# Paraphrases, not slop

These four files were generated for v2.2.0 by handing the model each original and asking it
to rewrite the piece in its own style. The model saw the original, so what came back is a
close paraphrase that keeps the author's sentences, order and particulars; it scored near the
human voice, not near machine prose. They are kept for reference only.

The slop fixtures the register tests use are `../<register>/slop.md`, written from the
original's proposition list alone (the model never sees the original).
